central_sigma_assumption.justification: Paired design: both arms share identical retrieval candidates per case, so per-case fractions are strongly correlated and paired differences concentrate near zero on the majority of cases; historical judge-vs-gate agreement on the old cohort was 1.0 at case level, so dispersion is driven only by cases where the judge changes admissions.

design: paired (both arms run every case; per-case outcome difference B minus A)
precision_statement: At N=40 the expected 95% CI half-width for the mean paired difference is 0.080 under central sigma; MDE for 80% power is 0.115 at central sigma and 0.16 at the conservative sigma (0.35).
primary_statistic: mean paired difference in per-case unsupported-admission fraction
sample_size_decision: N=40 (all eligible captures) exceeds the required n=24 for the preregistered effect target under the central sigma assumption (0.25); sample size fixed at the full eligible cohort.

smallest_effect_size_of_interest.justification: 0.15 absolute reduction in the per-case unsupported-admission fraction. On the frozen historical cohort the gate-only arm admitted a 0.741 candidate-level unsupported rate, and the judge demonstrably misses adjacent/ambiguous support, so the achievable headroom is bounded; a stage that changes fewer than roughly 1 in 7 admitted-evidence decisions does not justify its added latency and complexity in the deployed pipeline.

test: two-sided paired permutation (sign-flip, 100000 draws, frozen seed) with paired-t power approximation for design
